functions.name: orcus.lua
functions.sourceReview: Read the complete upstream dat/orcus.lua program (lines 1-159). The loader preserves mazegrid initialization, mazelevel and shortsighted flags, pre-map bounds selection, right-aligned and centered 45-by-17 map placement, mazewalk callback, unlit main region, fixed down stair, all 24 boulders, all 16 doors, sanctum altar, morgue and two shop regions, eight traps, ten random objects, rn2(2) marker-or-lamp compensation, fixed and random monster descriptors in source order, level-relative stair-up and branch regions, teleport region, protected selection union, and hell_tweaks. Selection coordinate conversion and hell_tweaks follow the existing selvar.lua and nhlib.lua ports; no unported callee or placeholder remains in this Lua program.

callers.source: The special-level registry dynamically imports orcus_levels.js and spreads ORCUS_LEVEL_LOADERS into SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS, making the Lua program available under the orcus proto name.
sp_lev.c load_special() resolves SPECIAL_LEVEL_LOADERS[name], creates the special-level descriptor API, invokes the orcus loader, and runs finish() post-processing.
mkmaze.c makemaz() resolves the orcus special-level proto during makelevel() when Is_special() selects Orcus's level, then dispatches it through load_special().

entryPointReview: The selected whole Lua program has one entry point: mkmaze.c makemaz() selects the orcus proto, load_special() dispatches the registered loader, and the descriptor API executes the complete dat/orcus.lua program. The independent wizard-mode teleport recipe reaches this dispatch and records the resulting full map, population, region, trap, object, and hell_tweaks generation trace.
